verdict.rationale: Navan is a travel and expense product, so mileage and per-diem claims are a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never mentions mileage logging, map-based distance calculation, or per-diem rates. The only nearby items are generic 'manage expenses', 'manual expenses' and 'receipt scanning', which are adjacent features and do not show this capability.

support.subject: As an employee, I can log mileage with map-based distance and claim per-diem rates without building the expense by hand
